title: Ka Panjira Ksiar (The Golden Cage)
author: E. Weston Dkhar
description: Literary drama exploring spiritual liberation, familial bonds, and human destiny symbolized by the golden birdcage.

Jylliew triem sak ki da ngam ;
Ki nangiar ki nangroi,
Sha jngai bak stet ki da laid :
Shano shuh phin dang khat,
Shisien bak ki la khlait ;
Bret tien sting thew ha thwei,
Jak ki ngam kloi lan ngi klet ;
Ki thnam phaloh lyngwiar,
Jngai ki pra jngai ki saphret ;
Kaba da tied pynpait,
Pynlwet jin ia dohnud lwait ;
Oh la bha ba tyngkan,
Ym lah don sabon ban sait.
Bret tien ieit tien sbun plom,
Ha thwei jak ki ngam ki jah ;
Ki thnam phaloh lyngwiar,
Ki phriang diar hajuh kim sah
Kit jingkmen jingkyrmen,
Jingtngen jun bad ka jingieit ;
Ba dohnud Iwait ka ap,
Swait ka kner la ka ban kheit :
To kren tien ieit f tien sbun,
Shi kh lipmat Jah ch ban kiet ;
Phalob lyngwiar ba shad,
Jngai jngai bak ki da phet stet :
K tap-lup pyrthei mariang,
Da jingsuk jingieit jingkmen ;
Ba dohnud ba Iwet jin
ka lap-dien jaka batngen.
